results.title: Trump's approval rating hits new lows in latest poll

results.content:
A Reuters/Ipsos poll released Aug. 31 found that 33% of Americans approved of Trump’s job performance, marking the third consecutive week at that level.

The 33% rating was Trump’s lowest in Reuters/Ipsos polling since he returned to the White House in 2025. It also matched his lowest approval rating during his first term, which came in December 2017.

The latest national figure was also below former President Joe Biden’s lowest approval rating, which reached 35% in October 2024. [...] The New York Times averages several other polls daily. Its data says Trump stands at 58% disapproval and 38% approval as of Sept. 1.

Only one in three Americans supports Trump, according to the most recent Reuters/Ipsos polls. The newest data, released Monday, Aug. 31, showed a 33% approval rating.

It was the lowest he's seen from that tracking tool since he returned to the White House in January 2025. It matches his worst approval rating in his first term, which was in December 2017.

Nationally, the Iran war, which has continued for six months, has low support. Only 36% of Americans approved of it. [...] Trump has a 45% approval rating in Mississippi, according to Aug. 31 polling data from Civiqs. That's the lowest ever for the state.
